card_arrival.name: card_arrival
card_arrival.description: Customer inquiry about when their physical debit/credit card will arrive, delivery tracking, or delays in card shipment.

card_linking.name: card_linking
card_linking.description: Questions regarding connecting or linking an external bank card, credit card, or payment method to the account.

exchange_rate.name: exchange_rate
exchange_rate.description: Questions about foreign currency exchange rates, conversion fees, weekend markup, or how exchange rates are calculated.

extra_charge_on_statement.name: extra_charge_on_statement
extra_charge_on_statement.description: Customer notices an unexpected extra charge, duplicate fee, or unexplained deduction on their account statement.

lost_or_stolen_card.name: lost_or_stolen_card
lost_or_stolen_card.description: Urgent notifications that a physical card has been lost, stolen, or compromised, and needs to be frozen or cancelled immediately.

top_up_reverted.name: top_up_reverted
top_up_reverted.description: Customer added funds or topped up their balance, but the top-up was cancelled, refunded, reversed, or failed to clear.

transfer_fee_charged.name: transfer_fee_charged
transfer_fee_charged.description: Customer asks why a fee or commission was applied to a money transfer, wire, or international payment.

verify_identity.name: verify_identity
verify_identity.description: Questions or issues concerning identity verification, KYC, passport/ID submission, selfie check, or verification pending status.

visa_or_mastercard.name: visa_or_mastercard
visa_or_mastercard.description: Inquiries regarding whether the card provided is Visa or Mastercard, network brand differences, or requesting a specific brand.

wrong_amount_additional_charge.name: wrong_amount_additional_charge
wrong_amount_additional_charge.description: The customer was charged a different total amount than what the merchant stated or authorized during purchase.
